maxItems.title: Maximum Articles
maxItems.description: Maximum number of tech articles and developer leads to extract.

tag.title: Tag / Topic Filter
tag.description: Filter articles by tag (e.g., python, javascript, ai, react, devops, webdev). Leave empty for general feed.

topDays.title: Top Period (Days)
topDays.description: Fetch top articles by timeframe (e.g. 7 for past week, 30 for past month, 365 for year). Set to 0 for rising/latest.

state.title: Content State
state.description: Feed stream mode: rising (trending discussions), fresh (newest), or all.
